assumptions: linear model (FA2 sections 13, 15): the verifier's view is the set of group vector entries, proximity entries and terminal values, each a public-coefficient linear form in base-field rows

masks and pads independent and uniform; challenges are seeded stand-ins avoiding the base field (the 2^-64 degeneracies FA2 excludes: e in Fp, lambda = 0, Fp-dependent prox rhos, a row-bit coordinate in Fp)

hashing, Merkle paths, salted leaves, the sampled columns / folded pads and the CFS-masked sumcheck round messages are outside the model (nonlinear); transcript conditioning (a simulator) is outside the model
integer-range side information and cross-proof correlation are outside the model

row bits are taken from the inventory's symbolic points (constants and shared symbols consistent); column tails are per-group stand-ins in the with-values models (n = 4 / 8 columns), which cannot represent the 8-coordinate tails
multi-row histogram slots (256 / 64 / 2 rows) are compressed to 2 rows in the with-values models (FA2's tiny-fixture convention); the per-column models use the real row counts
the two bilinear matmul terminals (score, PV) and, under P3, the QKV / Wo terminals carry the second-extension coefficient form ((1 - e2)(1 - e), (1 - e2) e); it changes no rank (FA3 section 9)
the six private claimed sums (inventory finding 2 / R6) and the CFS slot list (R5) are protocol items outside this linear model; nothing here settles them
numerical rank is not a simulation proof

row_cost.method: FA3 section 8: rows counted from the schedule; bytes per extra row = n * 8 * (1 + inv_rate) + Q * 8 (data + full coset encoding + host pads); salts and Merkle trees are per column and unchanged; proof size grows per GROUP (group vectors), not per row

rule: every single-row mask site is an Fp2 pair (re, im) carried in the claim as (k1, k1 u); every plane claim of the attention A / W is such a site whatever its data-row count (the row bits weight the data rows, the pair's two rows make it Fp2-effective); every multi-row histogram slot keeps the block form (rows_i >= 2) and a single-row slot is a pair; every proximity row is a pair; the two internal seam terminals are pair-masked claims on the attention A's own xm8 / z16c rows; the 19 helper sums become ONE zero-sum row u (sum_j u[j] = 0) added to the packed column-wise sum of the 19 helper columns minus the 10 g_T rows, masked by u itself (zero-sum pair) and the fresh pair u' at rho_zs; no collapse; every mask row drawn once before its commitment exists and consumed by exactly one opening (FA3 sections 1-4)
